title: Average Time Between Climate Events
scenario: For each city, calculate the average time gap between 'High' severity climate alerts.
tableSchema: climate_alerts (city_name VARCHAR, alert_type VARCHAR, alert_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Filter for 'High', use LEAD() to get time difference.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name, AVG(next_time - alert_time) FROM (SELECT city_name, alert_time, LEAD(alert_time) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY alert_time) as next_time FROM climate_alerts WHERE alert_type = 'High') t GROUP BY city_name;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE climate_alerts (city_name VARCHAR, alert_type VARCHAR, alert_time TIMESTAMP);
